tip: 'The more... the more' is a matched pair in Hindi: जितना (jitna = as much) opens, उतना ही (utna hi = that much) closes. One without the other sounds unfinished.
थूककर चाटना (thook-kar chaatna) is literally 'to spit, then lick it back up' – Hindi's image for breaking your word: reclaiming something you already put out.
सूचित किया जाता है (soochit kiya jaata hai = it is informed) never names who is informing. This doer-less passive is the standard opener of official Hindi notices.
पर्दा उठते ही (parda uthte hi) = 'the instant the curtain rose'. Verb + ते ही (te hi) squeezes a whole 'as soon as' clause into the verb plus one tiny word.
